nodes.title: SG-8.4 · Rewrite repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md is still the 71-line README-only draft with 13 UNKNOWN placeholders. The helpers docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts and the four context tests already exist in game/frontend. Desired behavior: context.md names Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest, TypeScript and Go for the backend, and has a module table with game/src/, game/frontend/src/, backend/ and game/docs/GDD.md. Expected result: contextStack and contextPaths unit tests pass. Why: the doc must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [] and the text matches /\bGo\b/.
- Given the repo-root context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and the text has no UNKNOWN.
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths is applied, then it includes game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists on disk.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md content as described by the two requirements
- In scope: doc contracts in docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Out of scope: SG-8.3 GDD work
- Out of scope: new features
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: All existing tests kept, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: game/src never imports game/frontend
- Preserve: every source file at most 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No test deleted or skipped; npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- contextStack and contextPaths tests pass
- typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: the current module table lists only README.md and .gitignore and says no src exists. Desired behavior: a module table with the four real paths and roles, backend/ marked as the Go service out of scope. Expected result: REQ-529 is satisfied and contextPaths tests pass. Why: the index must reference only paths that exist.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then it contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given those paths, when missingPaths runs with existsSync from the repo root, then the result is [].
- Given context.md, then it has no 'No `src/`' text and no 'README.md only' text.


## Scope
- In scope: Modules table of context.md
- In scope: contextModulePaths contract
- Out of scope: GDD content changes
- Preserve: game/docs/GDD.md as it is


## Technical constraints
- Reference only paths that exist
- No test deleted or skipped

- INT

- contextPaths.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts pass

nodes.title: Act: Confirm the STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT contracts for the context.md rewrite
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts exports STACK_TERMS (TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest) and STALE_TEXT, with staleTextHits and missingTerms. The rewritten Stack section of context.md must satisfy them; Devion writes context.md itself from this ticket, so this unit keeps the helper contract the doc is checked against accurate. Expected result: contract comments name Go as the extra regex-checked term and the UNKNOWN ban.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given docsCheck.ts, when read, then STACK_TERMS holds exactly the six terms and the doc comment names Go as checked by regex.
- Given docsCheck.ts, when staleTextHits is used, then STALE_TEXT still holds the three stale strings.


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts doc comments
- Out of scope: changing term values
- Preserve: export names and signatures


## Technical constraints
- File stays at most 200 lines
- No test deleted or skipped
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- docsCheck.ts exports unchanged and typecheck passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
